usage.useWhen: Long pages or articles with several h2 and h3 headings. display companion for long texts of about 2,500 words or more: a chapter button stays at the bottom edge once the list is scrolled away. In a post split with core/nextpage, one at the top of part 1: it shows at the top of every part, grouped by part with links to the other parts (scope all), or for the part being read alone (scope part).
usage.avoidWhen: Short pages with fewer than three headings.
usage.a11y: The list is a navigation landmark with links to the headings; the section being read is marked. The chapter button opens a modal dialog with the same list and returns focus when it closes; without JavaScript only the list remains.
